name: spring-tooltip
title: Spring Tooltip
description: One tooltip shared by a toolbar of icon buttons. It unfurls from a nub at the button, then travels: moving to a neighbour slides it across and resizes it on critically damped springs while a soft mask wipes the old label out and the new one in, and a fast sweep keeps its velocity instead of restarting. GSAP ticker, no provider.
docs:
Docs, props and examples: https://tween-ui.vercel.app/component/spring-tooltip
The component renders the buttons itself from an items array, so one tooltip can serve every trigger without a context provider.
